claims: The Players Championship is held annually at TPC Sawgrass in Ponte Vedra Beach, Florida.
The Players Championship is played on the Stadium Course at TPC Sawgrass.
The Stadium Course at TPC Sawgrass has been the permanent home of the Players Championship since 1982.
The Players Championship is typically held annually in March.
The Players Championship has the largest purse on the PGA Tour.
The Stadium Course at TPC Sawgrass was designed specifically for the Players Championship by Pete Dye
